newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE fuel oil bunkers gain, while Med prices steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil bunkers gain, while Med prices steady.

text.p: NWE fuel oil bunker prices gained on Friday as fuel oil swaps rose, but Mediterranean prices were flat, dealers said.
Gas oil prices rose in all areas after the jump of Nov IPE futures on Thursday.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil was quoted at $113/$114 fob, about $2 a tonne higher than on Thursday despite slightly weaker barge prices.
"The problem is that swaps are slightly higher for December and that's left sellers asking for more," one supplier said.
Traders said enquiries and resultant volumes were slight.
Hamburg meanwhile fell by $2 to $118 in what dealers described as a "peaceful" market.
Mediterranean fuel oil bunkers were flat. Traders said Med cargo prices held steady while NWE cargoes caught up with gains from earlier this week.
Fujairah bunkers were up around $2 a tonne despite steady Singapore prices. The rises came as existing commitments left suppliers unable to offer fuel oil before November 12.
